title: OXVA XLIM Pro 3 Pod Kit

The OXVA XLIM Pro 3 Pod Kit is the flagship XLIM device featuring OXVA's Pulse System for consistent flavour, a 1.05" HD colour display, and a 1500mAh battery. Adjustable wattage up to 40W with customizable themes and RGB lighting.

  • Product Type: Open Pod System (Refillable)
  • Battery: 1500mAh
  • Wattage Range: 5-40W
  • Charging: USB Type-C (2A Fast Charge)
  • Display: 1.05" HD Colour Screen
  • E-Liquid Capacity: 3mL
  • Coil Resistance: Integrated Mesh
  • Airflow: Adjustable (Side Slider)
  • Pod Compatibility: OXVA XLIM V3 Top Fill Pods (0.6Ω, 0.8Ω, 1.2Ω)
  • Brand: OXVA

E-liquid sold separately. Fill with your choice of salt nic or freebase e-liquid.
